fields.display_title: This paper investigates the training convergence of the general one-hidden-layer fully connected neural network  in a more general and practical scenario that the input features follow a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) distribution and proves that the GMM induced learning algorithm converges linearly to a critical point  of the empirical risk function. This result makes a progress on the training convergence study of this network.
